newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants, Chun Wo loan.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants, Chun Wo loan.

text.p: Chun Wo Holdings Ltd and China Merchants Holdings (Hong Kong) Co Ltd are expected to launch a HK$1.7 billion loan facility soon, bankers said.
The funds will be used to finance a private sector participation scheme (PSPS) project in Hong Kong, they said.
The loan will be launched through a special-purpose company, Grand View Properties Ltd, and will be guaranteed by China Merchants Holdings and Chun Wo Holdings.
The 2.5 year facility will pay an all-in return for top-tier managers of about 70 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Sanwa Bank and Westdeutsche Landesbank are the arrangers for the transaction.

Chun Wo Holdings said in April its 40 percent-owned Grand View Properties Ltd had been granted a land site in Kowloon for a project under the government's home ownership scheme at a premium of HK$810 million.
China Merchants Holdings owns 60 percent of Grand View.
